package be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.deck

import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.R
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.debug.CardPreviewAdapter
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.model.KnowledgeCard
import java.io.File

/**
 * Un adaptateur pour afficher une liste horizontale de KnowledgeCards.
 * Réutilise la vue item_card_preview pour une cohérence visuelle.
 *
 * @param onCardClicked Une fonction lambda appelée lorsqu'une carte est cliquée.
 */
class DeckCardAdapter(
    private var cards: List<KnowledgeCard>,
    private val onCardClicked: (KnowledgeCard) -> Unit
) : RecyclerView.Adapter<CardPreviewAdapter.ViewHolder>() {

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): CardPreviewAdapter.ViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
            .inflate(R.layout.item_card_preview, parent, false)
        return CardPreviewAdapter.ViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: CardPreviewAdapter.ViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val card = cards[position]
        holder.nameTextView.text = card.specificName

        // BOURDON'S REFACTOR: Remplacement de Glide par le chargement natif de Bitmap.
        card.imagePath?.let { path ->
            val imgFile = File(path)
            if (imgFile.exists()) {
                val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(imgFile.absolutePath)
                holder.imageView.setImageBitmap(bitmap)
            } else {
                holder.imageView.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_placeholder_card)
            }
        } ?: run {
            // Met une image par défaut si le chemin est nul
            holder.imageView.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_placeholder_card)
        }

        holder.itemView.setOnClickListener {
            onCardClicked(card)
        }
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = cards.size

    /**
     * Met à jour la liste des cartes affichées par l'adaptateur et notifie le changement.
     */
    fun updateCards(newCards: List<KnowledgeCard>) {
        this.cards = newCards
        notifyDataSetChanged()
    }
}

package be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.deck

import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.GridLayoutManager
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.R
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.debug.CardDetailsDialogFragment // BOURDON'S CORRECTION: This import resolves the reference.
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.model.KnowledgeCard

/**
 * Un Fragment qui affiche une grille de KnowledgeCards pour un seul deck.
 */
class DeckPageFragment : Fragment() {

    private lateinit var recyclerView: RecyclerView
    private lateinit var deckCardAdapter: DeckCardAdapter
    private var cards: ArrayList<KnowledgeCard>? = null

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        // Récupère les cartes passées en argument lors de la création du fragment.
        arguments?.let {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            cards = it.getParcelableArrayList(ARG_CARDS)
        }
    }

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater, container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View? {
        // Inflate le layout pour ce fragment.
        return inflater.inflate(R.layout.fragment_deck_page, container, false)
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        recyclerView = view.findViewById(R.id.deck_page_recyclerview)
        setupRecyclerView()
    }

    private fun setupRecyclerView() {
        // Initialise l'adaptateur avec la liste de cartes (ou une liste vide).
        deckCardAdapter = DeckCardAdapter(cards ?: emptyList()) { card ->
            // Affiche le dialogue des détails de la carte lorsqu'une carte est cliquée.
            CardDetailsDialogFragment.newInstance(card).show(parentFragmentManager, "CardDetailsDialog")
        }
        recyclerView.apply {
            // Utilise un GridLayoutManager pour afficher les cartes en grille de 2 colonnes.
            layoutManager = GridLayoutManager(context, 2)
            adapter = deckCardAdapter
        }
    }

    companion object {
        private const val ARG_CARDS = "cards_for_deck"

        /**
         * Méthode factory pour créer une nouvelle instance de ce fragment
         * avec une liste spécifique de cartes.
         *
         * @param cards La liste des cartes à afficher.
         * @return Une nouvelle instance de DeckPageFragment.
         */
        @JvmStatic
        fun newInstance(cards: List<KnowledgeCard>) =
            DeckPageFragment().apply {
                arguments = Bundle().apply {
                    // Les objets personnalisés doivent être Parcelable pour être passés dans un Bundle.
                    putParcelableArrayList(ARG_CARDS, ArrayList(cards))
                }
            }
    }
}

package be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.deck

import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import androidx.fragment.app.FragmentActivity
import androidx.viewpager2.adapter.FragmentStateAdapter
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.model.KnowledgeCard

/**
 * Un adaptateur qui fournit des fragments (DeckPageFragment) pour chaque deck de cartes
 * à un ViewPager2.
 *
 * @param fa L'activité hôte du fragment.
 * @param decks La map contenant les decks, où la clé est le nom du deck et la valeur est la liste des cartes.
 */
class DeckPagerAdapter(fa: FragmentActivity, private val decks: Map<String, List<KnowledgeCard>>) : FragmentStateAdapter(fa) {

    // Crée une liste des noms de decks pour un accès par indice.
    private val deckNames = decks.keys.toList()

    /**
     * Retourne le nombre total de decks (et donc de pages).
     */
    override fun getItemCount(): Int {
        return decks.size
    }

    /**
     * Crée et retourne un DeckPageFragment pour la position donnée.
     */
    override fun createFragment(position: Int): Fragment {
        val deckName = deckNames[position]
        val cardsForDeck = decks[deckName] ?: emptyList()
        // Utilise la méthode factory du fragment pour lui passer la liste de cartes.
        return DeckPageFragment.newInstance(cardsForDeck)
    }

    /**
     * Retourne le titre du deck pour l'onglet à la position donnée.
     */
    fun getPageTitle(position: Int): CharSequence {
        return deckNames[position]
    }
}

package be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.deck

import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.activity.viewModels
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.appcompat.widget.Toolbar
import androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import androidx.lifecycle.repeatOnLifecycle
import androidx.viewpager2.widget.ViewPager2
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.R
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.debug.CardDetailsDialogFragment
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.model.KnowledgeCard
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.quiz.QuizActivity
import com.google.android.material.tabs.TabLayout
import com.google.android.material.tabs.TabLayoutMediator
import dagger.hilt.android.AndroidEntryPoint
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

@AndroidEntryPoint
class DeckViewerActivity : AppCompatActivity(), CardDetailsDialogFragment.CardDetailsListener {

    private val viewModel: DeckViewerViewModel by viewModels()

    private lateinit var toolbar: Toolbar
    private lateinit var tabLayout: TabLayout
    private lateinit var viewPager: ViewPager2
    private lateinit var pagerAdapter: DeckPagerAdapter

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_deck_viewer)

        bindViews()
        setupToolbar()
        observeViewModel()
    }

    private fun bindViews() {
        toolbar = findViewById(R.id.deck_viewer_toolbar)
        tabLayout = findViewById(R.id.deck_tab_layout)
        viewPager = findViewById(R.id.deck_view_pager)
    }

    private fun setupToolbar() {
        toolbar.setNavigationOnClickListener {
            finish() // Ferme l'activité pour revenir à l'écran précédent
        }
    }

    private fun observeViewModel() {
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.STARTED) {
                viewModel.uiState.collect { state ->
                    if (state.isLoading) {
                        // Optionnel : Afficher un indicateur de chargement
                    } else {
                        // Une fois les données chargées, on configure le ViewPager et le TabLayout
                        pagerAdapter = DeckPagerAdapter(this@DeckViewerActivity, state.decks)
                        viewPager.adapter = pagerAdapter

                        // Lie le TabLayout au ViewPager pour la synchronisation
                        TabLayoutMediator(tabLayout, viewPager) { tab, position ->
                            tab.text = pagerAdapter.getPageTitle(position)
                        }.attach()
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // BOURDON'S ADDITION: Implementation of the listener from CardDetailsDialogFragment.
    override fun onDeleteCard(card: KnowledgeCard) {
        viewModel.deleteCard(card)
        Toast.makeText(this, "'${card.specificName}' a été supprimée.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }

    override fun onLaunchQuiz(card: KnowledgeCard) {
        // BOURDON'S FINAL REFACTOR: Launch the QuizActivity with the selected card.
        val intent = QuizActivity.newIntent(this, card)
        startActivity(intent)
    }
}

package be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.deck

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.model.KnowledgeCard
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.persistence.CardDao
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import javax.inject.Inject

/**
 * L'état de l'interface utilisateur pour l'écran de visualisation des decks.
 * @param isLoading Indique si les cartes sont en cours de chargement depuis la base de données.
 * @param decks Une map contenant les cartes groupées par leur nom de deck.
 */
data class DeckUiState(
    val isLoading: Boolean = true,
    val decks: Map<String, List<KnowledgeCard>> = emptyMap()
)

/**
 * Le ViewModel pour l'Activity qui affiche le Gardien Kikkō et ses decks de cartes.
 * Il est responsable de charger les données depuis la base de données et de les préparer pour l'affichage.
 */
@HiltViewModel
class DeckViewerViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val cardDao: CardDao
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(DeckUiState())
    val uiState = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    init {
        loadAllDecks()
    }

    /**
     * BOURDON'S ADDITION: Deletes a card from the database and refreshes the deck list.
     * @param card The KnowledgeCard to be deleted.
     */
    fun deleteCard(card: KnowledgeCard) {
        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            cardDao.delete(card)
            // After deletion, reload all decks to update the UI.
            // This is a simple and robust way to ensure UI consistency.
            loadAllDecks()
        }
    }

    /**
     * Charge toutes les cartes de la base de données, les groupe par deck,
     * et met à jour l'état de l'interface.
     */
    private fun loadAllDecks() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = true) }
            val groupedDecks = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                // Récupère toutes les cartes et les groupe par le `deckName`.
                cardDao.getAll().groupBy { it.deckName }
            }
            _uiState.update {
                it.copy(isLoading = false, decks = groupedDecks)
            }
        }
    }
}

package be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.di

import android.content.Context
import androidx.datastore.core.DataStore
import androidx.datastore.core.DataStoreFactory
import androidx.datastore.core.Serializer
import androidx.datastore.dataStoreFile
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.AppLifecycleProvider
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.GalleryLifecycleProvider
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.SettingsSerializer
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.data.DataStoreRepository
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.data.DefaultDataStoreRepository
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.data.DefaultDownloadRepository
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.data.DownloadRepository
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.persistence.CardDao // BOURDON'S FIX: Added import
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.proto.Settings
import dagger.Module
import dagger.Provides
import dagger.hilt.InstallIn
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
internal object AppModule {

  // Provides the SettingsSerializer
  @Provides
  @Singleton
  fun provideSettingsSerializer(): Serializer<Settings> {
    return SettingsSerializer
  }

  // Provides DataStore<Settings>
  @Provides
  @Singleton
  fun provideSettingsDataStore(
    @ApplicationContext context: Context,
    settingsSerializer: Serializer<Settings>,
  ): DataStore<Settings> {
    return DataStoreFactory.create(
      serializer = settingsSerializer,
      produceFile = { context.dataStoreFile("settings.pb") },
    )
  }

  // Provides AppLifecycleProvider
  @Provides
  @Singleton
  fun provideAppLifecycleProvider(): AppLifecycleProvider {
    return GalleryLifecycleProvider()
  }

  // Provides DataStoreRepository
  @Provides
  @Singleton
  fun provideDataStoreRepository(dataStore: DataStore<Settings>): DataStoreRepository {
    return DefaultDataStoreRepository(dataStore)
  }

  // Provides DownloadRepository
  @Provides
  @Singleton
  fun provideDownloadRepository(
    @ApplicationContext context: Context,
    lifecycleProvider: AppLifecycleProvider,
  ): DownloadRepository {
    return DefaultDownloadRepository(context, lifecycleProvider)
  }

  // BOURDON'S FIX: Added the provider for CardDao to resolve the Hilt injection error.
  @Provides
  @Singleton
  fun provideCardDao(@ApplicationContext context: Context): CardDao {
    return CardDao(context)
  }
}

            ))
        }
        mlkitReportHeader.setOnClickListener {
            mlkitReportTextView.isVisible = !mlkitReportTextView.isVisible
        }

        generateStatsButton.setOnClickListener { viewModel.generateStats() }
        generateQuizButton.setOnClickListener { viewModel.generateQuiz() }

    private fun startCameraIntent() {
        createTempPhotoUri().let { uri ->
            tempPhotoUri = uri
            takePhotoLauncher.launch(uri)
        }
    }

    private fun setupObservers() {
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.STARTED) {
                viewModel.uiState.collect { state ->
                    val isBusy = state.isInferring || state.isModelLoading || state.isAnalyzingMlKit

                    if (state.isInferring && state.streamingCharCount > 0) {
                        statusTextView.text = "${state.statusText} (${state.streamingCharCount} caractères)"
                    } else {
                        statusTextView.text = state.statusText
                    }

                    val modelNames = state.availableModels.map { it.name }
                    val currentAdapter = modelSpinner.adapter as? ArrayAdapter<String>
                    if (currentAdapter == null || currentAdapter.count != modelNames.size || (0 until currentAdapter.count).any { currentAdapter.getItem(it) != modelNames[it] }) {
                        val adapter = ArrayAdapter(this@ForgeActivity, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, modelNames)
                        adapter.setDropDownViewResource(android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item)
                        modelSpinner.adapter = adapter
                    }

                    state.selectedModel?.let { selectedModel ->
                        val position = modelNames.indexOf(selectedModel.name)
                        if (position >= 0 && modelSpinner.selectedItemPosition != position) {
                            modelSpinner.setSelection(position)
                        }
                    }

                    val hasPollen = state.pollenImages.isNotEmpty()
                    val hasPrompt = promptEditText.text?.isNotBlank() == true
                    runMlkitButton.isEnabled = !isBusy && hasPollen
                    runIdentificationButton.isEnabled = !isBusy && hasPollen && hasPrompt && !state.isModelLoading

                    pollenAdapter.updateImages(state.pollenImages)
                    pollenPlaceholderTextView.isVisible = !hasPollen
                    pollenPreviewRecyclerView.isVisible = hasPollen

                    if (state.generatedPrompt.isNotBlank() && promptEditText.text.toString() != state.generatedPrompt) {
                        promptEditText.setText(state.generatedPrompt)
                    }
                    mlkitReportTextView.text = state.mlKitReport
                    mlkitReportHeader.isVisible = state.mlKitReport.isNotBlank()


                    val card = state.forgedCard
                    resultCardContainer.isVisible = card != null
                    actionButtonsContainer.isVisible = card != null

                    if (card != null) {
                        cardSpecificName.text = card.specificName
                        cardDeckName.text = card.deckName
                        cardReasoning.text = "Visual: ${card.reasoning.visualAnalysis}\nCorrelation: ${card.reasoning.evidenceCorrelation}"

                        cardDescription.isVisible = !card.description.isNullOrBlank()
                        cardDescription.text = card.description

                        cardStats.isVisible = card.stats != null
                        cardStats.text = card.stats?.items?.entries?.joinToString("\n") { (key, value) -> "$key: $value" } ?: ""

                        val allergensList = card.allergens
                        if (!allergensList.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                            cardAllergensTitle.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                            cardAllergens.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                            cardAllergensTitle.text = "Allergènes (${allergensList.size}):"
                            cardAllergens.text = allergensList.joinToString(", ")
                        } else {
                            cardAllergensTitle.visibility = View.GONE
                            cardAllergens.visibility = View.GONE
                        }

                        val ingredientsList = card.ingredients
                        if (!ingredientsList.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                            cardIngredientsTitle.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                            cardIngredients.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                            cardIngredientsTitle.text = "Ingrédients (${ingredientsList.size}):"
                            cardIngredients.text = ingredientsList.joinToString(", ")
                        } else {
                            cardIngredientsTitle.visibility = View.GONE
                            cardIngredients.visibility = View.GONE
                        }

                        // BOURDON'S FIX: Check for null before populating the quiz container.
                        val quizList = card.quiz
                        cardQuizContainer.isVisible = !quizList.isNullOrEmpty()
                        if (!quizList.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                            populateQuizContainer(cardQuizContainer, quizList)
                        }


                        generateDescButton.isEnabled = !isBusy
                        generateDescButton.isVisible = state.isIdentificationReady && card.description == null

                        generateStatsButton.isEnabled = !isBusy
                        generateStatsButton.isVisible = card.description != null && card.stats == null

                        generateQuizButton.isEnabled = !isBusy
                        generateQuizButton.isVisible = card.stats != null && card.quiz == null

                        finishButton.isEnabled = !isBusy && state.isReadyToFinish
                        discardButton.isEnabled = !isBusy && state.isReadyToFinish
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun populateQuizContainer(container: LinearLayout, quiz: List<QuizQuestion>) {
        if (container.tag == quiz) return
        container.removeAllViews()
        container.tag = quiz

        quiz.forEachIndexed { index, quizQuestion ->
            val questionTextView = TextView(this).apply {
                text = "${index + 1}. ${quizQuestion.question}"
                setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD)
                setPadding(0, if (index > 0) 24 else 0, 0, 8)
            }
            container.addView(questionTextView)
            val optionsGroup = RadioGroup(this)
            // BOURDON'S FIX: Protect against null options list in a quiz question.
            quizQuestion.options?.forEachIndexed { optionIndex, option ->
                val radioButton = RadioButton(this).apply {
                    text = option
                    if (optionIndex == quizQuestion.correctAnswerIndex) {
                        setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD)
                        setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(this@ForgeActivity, R.color.kikko_success_green))
                    }
                }
                optionsGroup.addView(radioButton)
            }
            container.addView(optionsGroup)
        }
    }

    private fun setupModelSpinner() {
        modelSpinner.onItemSelectedListener = object : AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener {
            override fun onItemSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?, view: View?, position: Int, id: Long) {
                (parent?.getItemAtPosition(position) as? String)?.let {
                    if (it != viewModel.uiState.value.selectedModel?.name) {
                        viewModel.onModelSelected(it)
                    }
                }
            }
            override fun onNothingSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?) {}
        }
    }

    private fun handleImageUris(uris: List<Uri>) {
        lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val bitmaps = uris.mapNotNull { uri ->
                try {
                    contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use { BitmapFactory.decodeStream(it) }
                } catch (e: IOException) { null }
            }
            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) { viewModel.addPollenImages(bitmaps) }
        }
    }

    private fun createTempPhotoUri(): Uri {
        val tempFile = File.createTempFile("pollen_capture_${System.currentTimeMillis()}", ".jpg", cacheDir)
        return FileProvider.getUriForFile(this, "${packageName}.provider", tempFile)
    }
}

package be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.forge

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.util.Log
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.data.Accelerator
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.data.MAX_IMAGE_COUNT
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.data.Model
import com.google.mediapipe.framework.image.BitmapImageBuilder
import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.genai.llminference.GraphOptions
import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.genai.llminference.LlmInference
import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.genai.llminference.LlmInferenceSession

private const val TAG = "ForgeLlmHelper"

class ForgeLlmHelper(
    private val context: Context,
) {
    private var llmInference: LlmInference? = null
    private var session: LlmInferenceSession? = null

    fun initialize(model: Model, accelerator: String): String? {
        return try {
            val optionsBuilder = LlmInference.LlmInferenceOptions.builder()
                .setModelPath(model.url)
                .setMaxTokens(4096)
                .setPreferredBackend(
                    if (accelerator == Accelerator.GPU.label) LlmInference.Backend.GPU
                    else LlmInference.Backend.CPU
                )
                .setMaxNumImages(if (model.llmSupportImage) MAX_IMAGE_COUNT else 0)

            val options = optionsBuilder.build()
            llmInference = LlmInference.createFromOptions(context, options)
            session = createNewSession(model, llmInference!!)
            null
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            cleanUpMediapipeTaskErrorMessage(e.message ?: "Unknown error during initialization")
        }
    }

    private fun createNewSession(model: Model, llmInference: LlmInference): LlmInferenceSession {
        val sessionOptionsBuilder = LlmInferenceSession.LlmInferenceSessionOptions.builder()
            .setTemperature(0.2f)
            .setTopK(40)

        if (model.llmSupportImage) {
            sessionOptionsBuilder.setGraphOptions(
                GraphOptions.builder()
                    .setEnableVisionModality(true)
                    .build()
            )
        }
        return LlmInferenceSession.createFromOptions(llmInference, sessionOptionsBuilder.build())
    }

    fun resetSession(model: Model) {
        try {
            Log.d(TAG, "Resetting session for model '${model.name}' in Forge")
            session?.close()

            val inferenceEngine = llmInference ?: run {
                Log.e(TAG, "Cannot reset session, LlmInference engine is null.")
                return
            }

            session = createNewSession(model, inferenceEngine)
            Log.d(TAG, "Forge session has been reset successfully.")
        } catch(e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed to reset forge session for '${model.name}': ${e.message}")
            cleanUp()
        }
    }

    fun runInference(
        prompt: String,
        images: List<Bitmap>,
        resultListener: (partialResult: String, done: Boolean) -> Unit
    ) {
        val currentSession = session ?: run {
            resultListener("Erreur: Session non initialisée.", true)
            return
        }

        try {
            if (prompt.trim().isNotEmpty()) {
                currentSession.addQueryChunk(prompt)
            }

            if (images.isNotEmpty()) {
                for (image in images) {
                    val mpImage = BitmapImageBuilder(image).build()
                    currentSession.addImage(mpImage)
                }
            }

            currentSession.generateResponseAsync(resultListener)

        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Erreur durant l'inférence dans la Forge", e)
            resultListener(cleanUpMediapipeTaskErrorMessage(e.message ?: "Error during inference"), true)
        }
    }

    fun cleanUp() {
        session?.close()
        llmInference?.close()
        session = null
        llmInference = null
    }
}

/**
 * Fonction utilitaire locale pour nettoyer les messages d'erreur de MediaPipe.
 */
private fun cleanUpMediapipeTaskErrorMessage(message: String): String {
    val index = message.indexOf("=== Source Location Trace")
    if (index >= 0) {
        return message.substring(0, index).trim()
    }
    return message.trim()
}

package be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.forge

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.util.Log
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.model.ImageAnalysisReport
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.model.SimpleDetectedObject
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.model.SimpleImageLabel
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.model.SwarmAnalysisResult
import com.google.android.gms.tasks.Tasks
import com.google.mlkit.common.model.LocalModel
import com.google.mlkit.vision.common.InputImage
import com.google.mlkit.vision.label.ImageLabel
import com.google.mlkit.vision.label.ImageLabeling
import com.google.mlkit.vision.label.custom.CustomImageLabelerOptions
import com.google.mlkit.vision.label.defaults.ImageLabelerOptions
import com.google.mlkit.vision.objects.DetectedObject
import com.google.mlkit.vision.objects.ObjectDetection
import com.google.mlkit.vision.objects.defaults.ObjectDetectorOptions
import com.google.mlkit.vision.text.Text
import com.google.mlkit.vision.text.TextRecognition
import com.google.mlkit.vision.text.japanese.JapaneseTextRecognizerOptions
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.io.Closeable

object ForgeMlKitHelper {
    private const val TAG = "ForgeMlKitHelper"

    const val OCR = "ocr"
    const val OBJECT_DETECTION = "object_detection"
    const val DEFAULT_LABELING = "default_labeling"
    const val BIRDS_CLASSIFIER = "birds_classifier"
    const val INSECTS_CLASSIFIER = "insects_classifier"
    const val PLANTS_CLASSIFIER = "plants_classifier"
    const val FOOD_CLASSIFIER = "food_classifier"
    const val MOBILENET_V1 = "mobilenet_v1"
    const val EFFICIENTNET_LITE0 = "efficientnet_lite0"
    const val EFFICIENTNET_LITE1 = "efficientnet_lite1"
    const val EFFICIENTNET_LITE2 = "efficientnet_lite2"
    const val DEEP_OBJECT_ANALYSIS = "deep_object_analysis"

    fun runAnalysis(
        context: Context,
        images: List<Bitmap>,
        enabledModels: Map<String, Boolean>,
        onResult: (SwarmAnalysisResult) -> Unit
    ) {
        Log.d(TAG, "Lancement de l'analyse de l'essaim pour ${images.size} images. Modèles activés: ${enabledModels.filter { it.value }.keys}")
        CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Default).launch {
            val imageReports = mutableListOf<ImageAnalysisReport>()

            images.forEachIndexed { index, bitmap ->
                Log.d(TAG, "Analyse de l'image ${index + 1}/${images.size} de l'essaim...")
                val report = processSingleImage(context, bitmap, enabledModels)
                imageReports.add(report)
            }

            val swarmResult = SwarmAnalysisResult(reports = imageReports)
            Log.i(TAG, "Analyse complète de l'essaim terminée.")

            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                onResult(swarmResult)
            }
        }
    }

    private suspend fun processSingleImage(context: Context, bitmap: Bitmap, enabledModels: Map<String, Boolean>): ImageAnalysisReport {
        Log.d(TAG, "Traitement d'une seule image...")
        val clientsToClose = mutableListOf<Closeable>()
        var detectedObjects = emptyList<SimpleDetectedObject>()
        val classifierResults = mutableMapOf<String, List<SimpleImageLabel>>()
        var ocrText = ""

        try {
            val image = InputImage.fromBitmap(bitmap, 0)
            val tasks = mutableListOf<com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<*>>()
            val taskNames = mutableListOf<String>()

            if (enabledModels[OCR] == true) {
                Log.d(TAG, "Ajout de la tâche OCR à l'essaim.")
                val recognizer = TextRecognition.getClient(JapaneseTextRecognizerOptions.Builder().build())
                clientsToClose.add(recognizer)
                tasks.add(recognizer.process(image))
                taskNames.add(OCR)
            }
            if (enabledModels[OBJECT_DETECTION] == true) {
                Log.d(TAG, "Ajout de la tâche de Détection d'Objets à l'essaim.")
                val options = ObjectDetectorOptions.Builder().setDetectorMode(ObjectDetectorOptions.SINGLE_IMAGE_MODE).enableMultipleObjects().enableClassification().build()
                val detector = ObjectDetection.getClient(options)
                clientsToClose.add(detector)
                tasks.add(detector.process(image))
                taskNames.add(OBJECT_DETECTION)
            }
            if (enabledModels[DEFAULT_LABELING] == true) {
                Log.d(TAG, "Ajout de la tâche de Labellisation par Défaut à l'essaim.")
                val labeler = ImageLabeling.getClient(ImageLabelerOptions.DEFAULT_OPTIONS)
                clientsToClose.add(labeler)
                tasks.add(labeler.process(image))
                taskNames.add("Labels (Défaut)")
            }

            addCustomClassifierTask(enabledModels, BIRDS_CLASSIFIER, "aiy-tflite-vision-classifier-birds-v1-v3.tflite", image, tasks, taskNames, clientsToClose)
            addCustomClassifierTask(enabledModels, INSECTS_CLASSIFIER, "aiy-tflite-vision-classifier-insects-v1-v3.tflite", image, tasks, taskNames, clientsToClose)
            addCustomClassifierTask(enabledModels, PLANTS_CLASSIFIER, "aiy-tflite-vision-classifier-plants-v1-v3.tflite", image, tasks, taskNames, clientsToClose)
            addCustomClassifierTask(enabledModels, FOOD_CLASSIFIER, "aiy-tflite-vision-classifier-food-v1-v1.tflite", image, tasks, taskNames, clientsToClose)
            addCustomClassifierTask(enabledModels, MOBILENET_V1, "mobilenet_v1_1.0_224_quantized_1_metadata_1.tflite", image, tasks, taskNames, clientsToClose)
            addCustomClassifierTask(enabledModels, EFFICIENTNET_LITE0, "efficientnet_lite0.tflite", image, tasks, taskNames, clientsToClose)

            if (tasks.isNotEmpty()) {
                val results = Tasks.await(Tasks.whenAllSuccess<Any>(tasks))
                Log.i(TAG, "${results.size} tâches ML Kit terminées avec succès.")

                results.forEachIndexed { index, result ->
                    val taskName = taskNames[index]
                    when (result) {
                        is Text -> ocrText = result.text
                        is List<*> -> {
                            if (result.all { it is DetectedObject }) {
                                detectedObjects = (result as List<DetectedObject>).map { obj ->
                                    SimpleDetectedObject(labels = obj.labels.map { SimpleImageLabel(it.text, it.confidence) })
                                }
                            } else if (result.all { it is ImageLabel }) {
                                classifierResults[taskName] = (result as List<ImageLabel>).map { SimpleImageLabel(it.text, it.confidence) }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "L'une des tâches ML a échoué en mode complexe", e)
        } finally {
            Log.d(TAG, "Nettoyage de ${clientsToClose.size} clients ML Kit.")
            clientsToClose.forEach { it.close() }
        }

        return ImageAnalysisReport(detectedObjects, classifierResults, ocrText)
    }

    private fun addCustomClassifierTask(
        enabledModels: Map<String, Boolean>,
        modelKey: String,
        assetPath: String,
        image: InputImage,
        tasks: MutableList<com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<*>>,
        taskNames: MutableList<String>,
        clientsToClose: MutableList<Closeable>
    ) {
        if (enabledModels[modelKey] == true) {
            Log.d(TAG, "Ajout de la tâche du classifieur personnalisé '$modelKey' à l'essaim.")
            val localModel = LocalModel.Builder().setAssetFilePath(assetPath).build()
            val options = CustomImageLabelerOptions.Builder(localModel).setConfidenceThreshold(0.1f).build()
            val labeler = ImageLabeling.getClient(options)
            clientsToClose.add(labeler)
            tasks.add(labeler.process(image))
            taskNames.add(modelKey.replace("_classifier", "").replaceFirstChar { it.titlecase() })
        }
    }
}

package be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.forge

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.util.Log
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.data.Accelerator
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.data.MAX_IMAGE_COUNT
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.data.Model
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.debug.TtsService
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.model.CardStats
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.model.KnowledgeCard
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.model.QuizQuestion
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.model.Reasoning
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.model.SwarmAnalysisResult
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.persistence.CardDao
import com.google.gson.Gson
import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder
import com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.io.IOException
import java.util.Locale
import java.util.UUID
import javax.inject.Inject

private const val TAG = "ForgeViewModel"

private data class StatDetail(val value: Double, val unit: String)
private data class FoodStatsResult(
    val stats: Map<String, StatDetail>?,
    val ingredients: List<String>?,
    val allergens: List<String>?
)

data class Language(val code: String, val name: String, val speakers: Long)

enum class TranslationStep {
    IDLE, REASONING, DESCRIPTION, QUIZ, COMPLETED
}

data class ForgeUiState(
    val availableModels: List<Model> = emptyList(),
    val selectedModel: Model? = null,
    val selectedAccelerator: String = Accelerator.GPU.label,
    val isModelLoading: Boolean = false,
    val isInferring: Boolean = false,
    val statusText: String = "Chargement des modèles locaux...",
    val streamingCharCount: Int = 0,
    val pollenImages: List<Bitmap> = emptyList(),
    val currentCardId: Long? = null,
    val isAnalyzingMlKit: Boolean = false,
    val mlKitReport: String = "",
    val generatedPrompt: String = "",
    val swarmAnalysisResult: SwarmAnalysisResult? = null,
    val forgedCard: KnowledgeCard? = null,
    val isIdentificationReady: Boolean = false,
    val isDescriptionReady: Boolean = false,
    val isStatsReady: Boolean = false,
    val isQuizReady: Boolean = false,
    val isReadyToFinish: Boolean = false,
    val isTranslating: Boolean = false,
    val translationStep: TranslationStep = TranslationStep.IDLE,
    val availableLanguagesForTranslation: List<Language> = emptyList()
)


@HiltViewModel
class ForgeViewModel @Inject constructor(
    @ApplicationContext private val context: Context,
    private val cardDao: CardDao
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(ForgeUiState())
    val uiState = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    private var llmHelper: ForgeLlmHelper? = null
    private val identificationParser = StreamingJsonParser()
    private val gson = Gson()

    private val allLanguages = listOf(
        Language("ja", "Japonais", 128_000_000),
        Language("fr", "Français", 280_000_000)
    )

    init {
        loadLocalModels()
    }

    private fun loadLocalModels() {
        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val modelsDir = File(context.filesDir, "imported_models")
            val modelFiles = modelsDir.listFiles { _, name -> name.endsWith(".task") } ?: emptyArray()
            val llmModels = modelFiles.map { file ->
                Model(name = file.name, downloadFileName = file.name, url = file.absolutePath, sizeInBytes = file.length(), imported = true, llmSupportImage = file.name.contains("gemma-3n", ignoreCase = true))
            }.sortedBy { it.name }

            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                _uiState.update { it.copy(availableModels = llmModels, availableLanguagesForTranslation = allLanguages) }
                llmModels.firstOrNull()?.let { onModelSelected(it.name) } ?: _uiState.update { it.copy(statusText = "Aucun modèle local trouvé.") }
            }
        }
    }


    fun onModelSelected(modelName: String) {
        val model = _uiState.value.availableModels.find { it.name == modelName }
        if (model == null || (model == _uiState.value.selectedModel && llmHelper != null)) return

        _uiState.update { it.copy(isModelLoading = true, statusText = "Initialisation...", pollenImages = emptyList(), selectedModel = model) }
        resetFullState()

        llmHelper?.cleanUp()
        llmHelper = ForgeLlmHelper(context)

        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val error = llmHelper?.initialize(model, _uiState.value.selectedAccelerator)
            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                _uiState.update { it.copy(isModelLoading = false, statusText = if (error == null) "'${model.name}' est prête." else "Erreur: $error", selectedModel = if (error == null) model else null) }
            }
        }
    }

    fun onAcceleratorSelected(accelerator: String) {
        if (accelerator == _uiState.value.selectedAccelerator) return
        _uiState.update { it.copy(selectedAccelerator = accelerator) }
        _uiState.value.selectedModel?.let { onModelSelected(it.name) }
    }

    fun addPollenImages(images: List<Bitmap>) {
        val currentPollen = _uiState.value.pollenImages.toMutableList()
        currentPollen.addAll(images)
        val finalPollen = if (currentPollen.size > MAX_IMAGE_COUNT) currentPollen.take(MAX_IMAGE_COUNT) else currentPollen
        resetFullState()
        _uiState.update { it.copy(pollenImages = finalPollen) }
    }

    fun removePollenImage(index: Int) {
        val currentPollen = _uiState.value.pollenImages.toMutableList()
        if (index in currentPollen.indices) {
            currentPollen.removeAt(index)
            resetFullState()
            _uiState.update { it.copy(pollenImages = currentPollen) }
        }
    }

    fun runMlKitAnalysis(enabledModels: Map<String, Boolean>) {
        if (_uiState.value.pollenImages.isEmpty()) {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(statusText = "Veuillez d'abord récolter du pollen.") }
            return
        }
        resetFullState(keepPollen = true)
        _uiState.update { it.copy(isAnalyzingMlKit = true, statusText = "Les Abeilles analysent...") }

        ForgeMlKitHelper.runAnalysis(context, _uiState.value.pollenImages, enabledModels) { swarmResult ->
            val readableReport = GsonBuilder().setPrettyPrinting().create().toJson(swarmResult)
            val finalPrompt = PromptGenerator.generateSwarmSynthesisPrompt(swarmResult)
            _uiState.update { it.copy(isAnalyzingMlKit = false, statusText = "Rapport terminé. Prêt pour l'identification.", mlKitReport = readableReport, generatedPrompt = finalPrompt, swarmAnalysisResult = swarmResult) }
        }
    }

    fun runIdentification(prompt: String) {
        if (_uiState.value.isInferring || _uiState.value.pollenImages.isEmpty()) return
        identificationParser.reset()
        _uiState.update { it.copy(isInferring = true, statusText = "Étape 1: La Reine identifie...", streamingCharCount = 0) }
        Log.d(TAG, "--- PROMPT POUR IDENTIFICATION ---\n$prompt")

        val responseBuilder = StringBuilder()
        llmHelper?.runInference(prompt, _uiState.value.pollenImages) { partialResult, done ->
            responseBuilder.append(partialResult)
            _uiState.update { it.copy(streamingCharCount = responseBuilder.length) }
            if (done) {
                Log.i(TAG, "--- RÉPONSE BRUTE DE L'IDENTIFICATION ---\n${responseBuilder.toString()}")
                viewModelScope.launch {
                    val finalResult = identificationParser.process(responseBuilder.toString())
                    if (finalResult.isComplete) {
                        val imageToSave = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { _uiState.value.pollenImages.firstOrNull()?.let { saveBitmapToPermanentStorage(it) } }
                        val newCard = KnowledgeCard(
                            specificName = finalResult.specificName,
                            deckName = finalResult.deckName,
                            imagePath = imageToSave,
                            confidence = finalResult.confidence,
                            reasoning = Reasoning(visualAnalysis = finalResult.reasoning["visualAnalysis"] ?: "", evidenceCorrelation = finalResult.reasoning["evidenceCorrelation"] ?: ""),
                            description = null, stats = null, allergens = null, ingredients = null, quiz = null, translations = null
                        )
                        val newId = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { cardDao.insert(newCard) }
                        val savedCard = newCard.copy(id = newId)
                        _uiState.update { it.copy(isInferring = false, statusText = "Carte créée ! Prêt pour l'étape 2.", streamingCharCount = 0, currentCardId = newId, forgedCard = savedCard, isIdentificationReady = true, isReadyToFinish = true) }
                    } else {
                        _uiState.update { it.copy(isInferring = false, streamingCharCount = 0, statusText = "Erreur: La réponse de la Reine était incomplète.") }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun generateDescription() {
        val cardId = _uiState.value.currentCardId ?: return
        if (_uiState.value.isInferring) return

        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value.selectedModel?.let { llmHelper?.resetSession(it) }
            _uiState.update { it.copy(isInferring = true, statusText = "Étape 2: La Reine forge la description...", streamingCharCount = 0) }

            val card = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { cardDao.getCardById(cardId) } ?: return@launch
            val prompt = PromptGenerator.generateNarrationDescriptionPrompt(card.specificName, card.deckName, Locale.ENGLISH)
            Log.d(TAG, "--- PROMPT POUR DESCRIPTION ---\n$prompt")

            val responseBuilder = StringBuilder()
            llmHelper?.runInference(prompt, emptyList()) { partialResult, done ->
                responseBuilder.append(partialResult)
                _uiState.update { it.copy(streamingCharCount = responseBuilder.length) }
                if (done) {
                    Log.i(TAG, "--- RÉPONSE BRUTE DE LA DESCRIPTION ---\n${responseBuilder.toString()}")
                    val updatedCard = card.copy(description = responseBuilder.toString().trim())
                    viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                        cardDao.update(updatedCard)
                        withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                            _uiState.update { it.copy(isInferring = false, streamingCharCount = 0, statusText = "Description ajoutée.", forgedCard = updatedCard, isDescriptionReady = true) }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun generateStats() {
        val cardId = _uiState.value.currentCardId ?: return
        if (_uiState.value.isInferring) return

        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value.selectedModel?.let { llmHelper?.resetSession(it) }
            _uiState.update { it.copy(isInferring = true, statusText = "Étape 3: La Reine extrait les stats...", streamingCharCount = 0) }

            val card = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { cardDao.getCardById(cardId) } ?: return@launch
            val description = card.description ?: ""
            val lowerSpecificName = card.specificName.lowercase(Locale.getDefault())

            val prompt = when (card.deckName) {
                "Food" -> {
                    val aggregatedOcr = _uiState.value.swarmAnalysisResult?.reports?.joinToString("\n") { it.ocrText }?.trim() ?: ""
                    PromptGenerator.generateFoodStatsPrompt(lowerSpecificName, aggregatedOcr, description)
                }
                "Plant" -> PromptGenerator.generatePlantStatsPrompt(lowerSpecificName, description)
                "Bird" -> PromptGenerator.generateBirdStatsPrompt(lowerSpecificName, description)
                "Insect" -> PromptGenerator.generateInsectStatsPrompt(lowerSpecificName, description)
                else -> ""
            }

            if (prompt.isEmpty()) {
                _uiState.update { it.copy(isInferring = false, statusText = "Erreur: Deck inconnu.") }
                return@launch
            }

            Log.d(TAG, "--- PROMPT POUR STATS (${card.deckName}) ---\n$prompt")
            val responseBuilder = StringBuilder()
            llmHelper?.runInference(prompt, emptyList()) { partialResult, done ->
                responseBuilder.append(partialResult)
                _uiState.update { it.copy(streamingCharCount = responseBuilder.length) }
                if (done) {
                    Log.i(TAG, "--- RÉPONSE BRUTE DES STATS ---\n${responseBuilder.toString()}")
                    val rawJson = responseBuilder.toString().trim()
                    val updatedCard = when (card.deckName) {
                        "Food" -> {
                            val foodResult = parseFoodStatsResult(rawJson)
                            val simplifiedStats = foodResult?.stats?.mapValues { "${it.value.value} ${it.value.unit}" }
                            card.copy(
                                stats = simplifiedStats?.let { CardStats("Statistics", it) },
                                ingredients = foodResult?.ingredients,
                                allergens = foodResult?.allergens
                            )
                        }
                        else -> card.copy(stats = parseStats(rawJson))
                    }
                    viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                        cardDao.update(updatedCard)
                        withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                            _uiState.update { it.copy(isInferring = false, streamingCharCount = 0, statusText = "Stats ajoutées.", forgedCard = updatedCard, isStatsReady = true) }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun generateQuiz() {
        val cardId = _uiState.value.currentCardId ?: return
        if (_uiState.value.isInferring) return

        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value.selectedModel?.let { llmHelper?.resetSession(it) }
            _uiState.update { it.copy(isInferring = true, statusText = "Étape 4: La Reine conçoit le quiz...", streamingCharCount = 0) }

            val card = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { cardDao.getCardById(cardId) } ?: return@launch
            val prompt = PromptGenerator.generateQuizPrompt(card.specificName, card.description ?: "", card.stats)
            Log.d(TAG, "--- PROMPT POUR QUIZ ---\n$prompt")
            val responseBuilder = StringBuilder()
            llmHelper?.runInference(prompt, emptyList()) { partialResult, done ->
                responseBuilder.append(partialResult)
                _uiState.update { it.copy(streamingCharCount = responseBuilder.length) }
                if (done) {
                    Log.i(TAG, "--- RÉPONSE BRUTE DU QUIZ ---\n${responseBuilder.toString()}")
                    val quiz = parseQuiz(responseBuilder.toString().trim())
                    val updatedCard = card.copy(quiz = quiz)
                    viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                        cardDao.update(updatedCard)
                        withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                            _uiState.update { it.copy(isInferring = false, streamingCharCount = 0, statusText = "Quiz ajouté.", forgedCard = updatedCard, isQuizReady = true) }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun discardForgedResult() {
        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            _uiState.value.currentCardId?.let { cardId ->
                cardDao.getCardById(cardId)?.let { cardDao.delete(it) }
            }
            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                resetFullState()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun resetFullState(keepPollen: Boolean = false) {
        _uiState.update { currentState ->
            currentState.selectedModel?.let {
                llmHelper?.resetSession(it)
            }
            ForgeUiState(
                pollenImages = if (keepPollen) currentState.pollenImages else emptyList(),
                availableModels = currentState.availableModels,
                selectedModel = currentState.selectedModel,
                selectedAccelerator = currentState.selectedAccelerator,
                statusText = if (currentState.selectedModel != null) "'${currentState.selectedModel?.name}' est prête." else "Veuillez sélectionner un modèle."
            )
        }
    }

    private suspend fun saveBitmapToPermanentStorage(bitmap: Bitmap): String? {
        return withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
                val cardImagesDir = File(context.filesDir, "card_images")
                if (!cardImagesDir.exists()) cardImagesDir.mkdirs()
                val permanentFile = File(cardImagesDir, "card_${UUID.randomUUID()}.png")
                FileOutputStream(permanentFile).use { out ->
                    bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, out)
                }
                permanentFile.absolutePath
            } catch (e: IOException) {
                e.printStackTrace()
                null
            }
        }
    }

    private fun parseStats(jsonString: String): CardStats? {
        return try {
            val firstBrace = jsonString.indexOf('{')
            val lastBrace = jsonString.lastIndexOf('}')
            if (firstBrace == -1 || lastBrace == -1) return null
            val cleanJson = jsonString.substring(firstBrace, lastBrace + 1)
            val type = object : TypeToken<Map<String, String>>() {}.type
            CardStats(title = "Statistics", items = gson.fromJson(cleanJson, type))
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Erreur de parsing des stats simples: $jsonString", e)
            null
        }
    }

    private fun parseFoodStatsResult(jsonString: String): FoodStatsResult? {
        return try {
            val firstBrace = jsonString.indexOf('{')
            val lastBrace = jsonString.lastIndexOf('}')
            if (firstBrace == -1 || lastBrace == -1) return null
            val cleanJson = jsonString.substring(firstBrace, lastBrace + 1)
            gson.fromJson(cleanJson, FoodStatsResult::class.java)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Erreur de parsing des stats FOOD: $jsonString", e)
            null
        }
    }

    private fun parseQuiz(jsonString: String): List<QuizQuestion> {
        return try {
            val firstBracket = jsonString.indexOf('[')
            val lastBracket = jsonString.lastIndexOf(']')
            if (firstBracket == -1 || lastBracket == -1) return emptyList()
            val cleanJson = jsonString.substring(firstBracket, lastBracket + 1)
            val type = object : TypeToken<List<QuizQuestion>>() {}.type
            gson.fromJson(cleanJson, type) ?: emptyList()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Erreur de parsing du quiz: $jsonString", e)
            emptyList()
        }
    }

    override fun onCleared() {
        super.onCleared()
        llmHelper?.cleanUp()
        TtsService.shutdown()
    }
}

/**
 * Un adaptateur pour le RecyclerView qui affiche une prévisualisation horizontale
 * des images (pollen) sélectionnées par l'utilisateur.
 *
 * @param pollenImages La liste mutable des bitmaps à afficher.
 * @param onRemoveClick Une fonction lambda appelée lorsqu'un utilisateur clique sur le bouton de suppression
 * d'une image, passant l'index de l'image à supprimer.
 */
class PollenPreviewAdapter(
    private val pollenImages: MutableList<Bitmap>,
    private val onRemoveClick: (Int) -> Unit
) : RecyclerView.Adapter<PollenPreviewAdapter.PollenViewHolder>() {

    /**
     * ViewHolder qui contient les vues pour un seul item de prévisualisation de pollen.
     */
    inner class PollenViewHolder(view: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(view) {
        val imageView: ImageView = view.findViewById(R.id.pollen_preview_imageview)
       /* val removeButton//: ImageButton = view.findViewById(R.id.pollen_remove_button)

        init {
            removeButton.setOnClickListener {
                // S'assure que la position est valide avant de déclencher le callback
                val position = adapterPosition
                if (position != RecyclerView.NO_POSITION) {
                    onRemoveClick(position)
                }
            }
        }

        */
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): PollenViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
            .inflate(R.layout.item_pollen_preview, parent, false)
        return PollenViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: PollenViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val bitmap = pollenImages[position]
        holder.imageView.setImageBitmap(bitmap)
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = pollenImages.size

    /**
     * Met à jour la liste des images affichées par l'adaptateur.
     * @param newImages La nouvelle liste de bitmaps.
     */
    fun updateImages(newImages: List<Bitmap>) {
        pollenImages.clear()
        pollenImages.addAll(newImages)
        notifyDataSetChanged()
    }
}

object PromptGenerator {

    private val majorAllergensList = listOf(
        "Cereals containing gluten", "Crustaceans", "Eggs", "Fish", "Peanuts",
        "Soybeans", "Milk", "Nuts", "Celery", "Mustard", "Sesame seeds",
        "Sulphur dioxide and sulphites", "Lupin", "Molluscs"

    fun generateSwarmSynthesisPrompt(swarmResult: SwarmAnalysisResult): String {
        val gson = Gson()
        val classifierNameMapping = mapOf(
            "Oiseaux (IAY)" to "aiy_birds",
            "Insectes (IAY)" to "aiy_insects",
            "Plantes (IAY)" to "aiy_plants",
            "Nourriture (IAY)" to "aiy_food",
            "Labels (Défaut)" to "mlkit_default",
            "MobileNetV1" to "mobilenetv1",
            "EfficientNet-Lite0" to "efficientnet_lite0"
        )

        val simplifiedReports = swarmResult.reports.mapIndexed { index, report ->
            mapOf(
                "image_index" to index + 1,
                "obj" to report.detectedObjects
                    .filter { it.labels.isNotEmpty() && !it.labels.first().text.equals("unknown", ignoreCase = true) }
                    .map { obj -> mapOf("l" to (obj.labels.firstOrNull()?.text ?: "unknown"), "c" to String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", obj.labels.firstOrNull()?.confidence ?: 0f).toFloat()) },
                "lbl" to report.globalClassifierResults.flatMap { (classifierName, labels) ->
                    val labelsToProcess = if (classifierName == "Labels (Défaut)") labels.take(4) else labels
                    labelsToProcess
                        .filter { it.text.isNotBlank() && !it.text.equals("None", ignoreCase = true) }
                        .map { label -> mapOf("s" to (classifierNameMapping[classifierName] ?: classifierName), "l" to label.text, "c" to String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", label.confidence).toFloat()) }
                },
                "ocr" to report.ocrText
            )
        }

        val reportsJson = gson.toJson(simplifiedReports)
        val validDecks = "`Bird`, `Insect`, `Plant`, `Food`, `Object`"

        return """
        ROLE: You are the AI Queen of the Kikko Hive, an expert in multimodal synthesis and conceptual reasoning.

        CONTEXT: You are receiving a "swarm" of ${swarmResult.reports.size} visual clues (images) and their corresponding intelligence reports from your Specialist Bees (JSON data array).

        TASK: Follow this strict reasoning process:
        1.  **Per-Clue Analysis**: Briefly analyze each image and its JSON report to understand its individual subject.
        2.  **Conceptual Synthesis**: Compare all your analyses. Identify the SINGLE unifying theme, process, or relationship that connects ALL the clues.
        3.  **Final Ruling**: Based on your synthesis, formulate a single, unified `specificName` and select the most appropriate `deckName`. The `specificName` must be the general identity of the subject, avoiding specific details like ingredients or flavors that can be extracted later as stats.

        OUTPUT FORMAT: Your response MUST be a single, valid JSON object, starting with `{` and ending with `}`. Do NOT add any markdown code fences.
        The `deckName` MUST be one of these values: $validDecks.
        The `reasoning` object must explain your synthesis process.
        **IMPORTANT**: Never use double quotes `"` inside a JSON string value. Use single quotes `'` or other characters instead.

        Example for a 2-image input (front and back of a cookie box):
        {
          "reasoning": {
            "visualAnalysis": "The images show the front of a cookie box, establishing the product's brand and type, and the back of the box, detailing its ingredients.",
            "evidenceCorrelation": "Report for image 1 confirms 'Cookie' via object detection. Report for image 2's OCR provides the ingredients list. The synthesis combines these views to identify the complete product."
          },
          "deckName": "Food",
          "specificName": "Kikko Cookies",
          "confidence": 0.99
        }

        --- START OF DATA ---
        INTELLIGENCE REPORTS (JSON Array):
        $reportsJson
        """.trimIndent()
    }

    }

    OUTPUT FORMAT: A single JSON object.

    "$description"
    """.trimIndent()

    fun generateQuizPrompt(subject: String, description: String, stats: CardStats?): String {

        // BOURDON'S FIX: The language is now hardcoded to English for consistency.

    CRITICAL RULE: You MUST NOT invent, infer, or use any external knowledge. All questions and correct answers must be directly verifiable from the text in `[DESCRIPTION]` or the data in `[STATS_DATA]`. Do not create questions about topics not mentioned in the provided context.

    OUTPUT FORMAT: Your response MUST be a single, valid JSON array, with no other explanatory text. The content of the quiz (questions and answers) must be in $languageName.
    Format: `[{"q": "...", "o": ["...", "...", "...", "..."], "c": correct_index}]`
    **IMPORTANT**: Never use double quotes `"` inside a JSON string value (like in the question "q" or options "o"). Use single quotes `'` or other characters instead.

    --- START OF DATA ---

    [DESCRIPTION]:
    "$description"

    [STATS_DATA]:
    $statsJson
    """.trimIndent()
    }
    fun generateClashVerdictPrompt(question: String, card1: KnowledgeCard, card2: KnowledgeCard): String {
        val player1Name = card1.specificName.lowercase(Locale.getDefault())
        val player2Name = card2.specificName.lowercase(Locale.getDefault())

        return """

        TASK: Structure your reasoning as a spoken monologue, following these steps precisely:
        1.  Start with a dramatic opening.
        2.  Announce the first contestant, ${player1Name}.
        3.  State one key strength ('Strong Point') of ${player1Name} regarding the question.
        4.  State one key weakness ('Weak Point') of ${player1Name} regarding the question.
        5.  Announce the second contestant, ${player2Name}.
        6.  State one key strength ('Strong Point') of ${player2Name}.
        7.  State one key weakness ('Weak Point') of ${player2Name}.
        8.  Build suspense, then declare the winner. The winner must be based on a logical comparison of their strengths and weaknesses in the context of the question.

        OUTPUT FORMAT: Your response MUST be a single, valid JSON object and NOTHING ELSE.
        - The `reasoning` key must contain your complete monologue.
        - The `winner` key is CRITICAL. It MUST contain ONLY ONE of these exact three strings: "player1", "player2", or "tie". DO NOT use the name of the card.

        Example of a PERFECT output:
        {
          "reasoning": "After much deliberation, considering the powerful roots of the raspberry bush versus the tomato plant's resilience, the victor is clear...",
          "winner": "player2"
        }

        --- START OF DUEL DATA ---

        [CLASH_QUESTION]:
        "$question"

        player1: "$player1Name"
        player2: "$player2Name"
        """.trimIndent()
    }

    fun generateClashAnnouncementPrompt(
        question: String,

    ): String {
        val languageName = "English"

        1.  Start with an exciting opening to grab attention.
        2.  Announce the winner in a clear and celebratory way.

package be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.forge

import com.google.gson.Gson
import com.google.gson.JsonSyntaxException
import com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken

/**
 * Contient le résultat partiel ou complet d'une analyse JSON en streaming.
 */
data class ParsedJsonResult(
    val specificName: String = "",
    val deckName: String = "",
    val reasoning: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
    val isComplete: Boolean = false,
    val confidence: Float = 0.0f
)

/**
 * Un analyseur capable de traiter un flux de texte JSON entrant et d'en extraire
 * des champs de manière progressive.
 */
class StreamingJsonParser {

    private val gson = Gson()
    private var buffer = ""

    /**
     * Traite un nouveau morceau de texte et tente de l'analyser en tant que JSON.
     * @param chunk Le nouveau morceau de texte reçu du flux.
     * @return Un objet [ParsedJsonResult] contenant les données extraites.
     */
    fun process(chunk: String): ParsedJsonResult {
        buffer += chunk

        // Tente de trouver le début et la fin de l'objet JSON principal.
        val firstBrace = buffer.indexOf('{')
        val lastBrace = buffer.lastIndexOf('}')

        if (firstBrace == -1 || lastBrace == -1 || lastBrace < firstBrace) {
            // Pas encore un objet JSON valide.
            return ParsedJsonResult()
        }

        val potentialJson = buffer.substring(firstBrace, lastBrace + 1)

        return try {
            val type = object : TypeToken<Map<String, Any>>() {}.type
            val data: Map<String, Any> = gson.fromJson(potentialJson, type)

            val reasoningMap = (data["reasoning"] as? Map<String, Any>)?.mapValues { it.value.toString() } ?: emptyMap()
            val confidenceDouble = data["confidence"] as? Double

            ParsedJsonResult(
                specificName = data["specificName"]?.toString() ?: "",
                deckName = data["deckName"]?.toString() ?: "",
                reasoning = reasoningMap,
                confidence = confidenceDouble?.toFloat() ?: 0.0f,
                isComplete = true // Le JSON principal est syntaxiquement correct.
            )
        } catch (e: JsonSyntaxException) {
            // Le JSON est incomplet, on essaie d'extraire des champs partiels.
            extractPartial(potentialJson)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Tente d'extraire des valeurs de champs individuels d'un JSON potentiellement incomplet.
     */
    private fun extractPartial(jsonString: String): ParsedJsonResult {
        val specificName = extractStringValue(jsonString, "specificName")
        val deckName = extractStringValue(jsonString, "deckName")
        // L'extraction partielle de l'objet "reasoning" est plus complexe et est omise pour la simplicité.

        return ParsedJsonResult(
            specificName = specificName,
            deckName = deckName
        )
    }

    private fun extractStringValue(json: String, key: String): String {
        val keyPattern = "\"$key\"\\s*:\\s*\""
        val regex = keyPattern.toRegex()
        val match = regex.find(json) ?: return ""

        val startIndex = match.range.last + 1
        val endIndex = json.indexOf('"', startIndex)

        return if (endIndex != -1) {
            json.substring(startIndex, endIndex)
        } else {
            // La chaîne est peut-être en cours de streaming.
            json.substring(startIndex)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Réinitialise le buffer pour une nouvelle analyse.
     */
    fun reset() {
        buffer = ""
    }
}

--- START OF FILE app/src/main/java/be/heyman/android/ai/kikko/persistence/CardDao.kt ---

package be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.persistence

import android.content.Context
import com.google.gson.Gson
import com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken
import be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.model.KnowledgeCard
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileReader
import java.io.FileWriter

class CardDao(context: Context) {
    private val gson = Gson()
    private val dbFile = File(context.filesDir, "kikko_saga.json")
    private val type = object : TypeToken<MutableList<KnowledgeCard>>() {}.type

    private suspend fun readCards(): MutableList<KnowledgeCard> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        if (!dbFile.exists()) {
            mutableListOf()
        } else {
            try {
                FileReader(dbFile).use { reader ->
                    gson.fromJson(reader, type) ?: mutableListOf()
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                // En cas de fichier corrompu, retourne une liste vide.
                mutableListOf()
            }
        }
    }

    private suspend fun writeCards(cards: List<KnowledgeCard>) = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        FileWriter(dbFile).use { writer ->
            gson.toJson(cards, writer)
        }
    }

    suspend fun insert(card: KnowledgeCard): Long = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val cards = readCards()
        val newId = (cards.maxOfOrNull { it.id } ?: 0L) + 1L
        cards.add(card.copy(id = newId))
        writeCards(cards)
        newId
    }

    suspend fun getAll(): List<KnowledgeCard> {
        return readCards().sortedByDescending { it.id }
    }

    suspend fun getCardById(id: Long): KnowledgeCard? {
        return readCards().find { it.id == id }
    }

    /**
     * BOURDON'S FIX: Réintroduction de la méthode requise par les anciens modules de Clash.
     * Cette méthode récupère toutes les cartes puis les filtre en mémoire.
     */
    suspend fun getCardsByDeck(deckName: String): List<KnowledgeCard> {
        return readCards().filter { it.deckName.equals(deckName, ignoreCase = true) }
    }

    suspend fun update(card: KnowledgeCard) {
        val cards = readCards()
        val index = cards.indexOfFirst { it.id == card.id }
        if (index != -1) {
            cards[index] = card
            writeCards(cards)
        }
    }

    suspend fun delete(card: KnowledgeCard) {
        val cards = readCards()
        cards.removeIf { it.id == card.id }
        writeCards(cards)
    }

    suspend fun nuke() {
        writeCards(emptyList())
    }
}

--- END OF FILE app/src/main/java/be/heyman/android/ai/kikko/persistence/CardDao.kt ---


--- START OF FILE app/src/main/java/be/heyman/android/ai/kikko/persistence/DatabaseHelper.kt ---

package be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.persistence

import android.content.Context
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteOpenHelper
import android.util.Log

class DatabaseHelper(context: Context) : SQLiteOpenHelper(context, DATABASE_NAME, null, DATABASE_VERSION) {

    companion object {
        private const val DATABASE_NAME = "kikko.db"
        // BOURDON'S FIX: Incremented version to 4 for the new translations column.
        private const val DATABASE_VERSION = 4

        // --- Table "knowledge_cards" Definition ---
        const val TABLE_CARDS = "knowledge_cards"
        const val COLUMN_ID = "id"
        const val COLUMN_SPECIFIC_NAME = "specificName"
        const val COLUMN_DECK_NAME = "deckName"
        const val COLUMN_IMAGE_PATH = "imagePath"
        const val COLUMN_CONFIDENCE = "confidence"
        const val COLUMN_DESCRIPTION = "description"
        const val COLUMN_REASONING_JSON = "reasoning"
        const val COLUMN_STATS_JSON = "stats"
        const val COLUMN_ALLERGENS_JSON = "allergens"
        const val COLUMN_INGREDIENTS_JSON = "ingredients"
        const val COLUMN_QUIZ_JSON = "quiz"
        // BOURDON'S FIX: Added a new column to store the translations map as a JSON string.
        const val COLUMN_TRANSLATIONS_JSON = "translations"

        private const val TABLE_CREATE =
            "CREATE TABLE $TABLE_CARDS (" +
                    "$COLUMN_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, " +
                    "$COLUMN_SPECIFIC_NAME TEXT, " +
                    "$COLUMN_DECK_NAME TEXT, " +
                    "$COLUMN_IMAGE_PATH TEXT, " +
                    "$COLUMN_CONFIDENCE REAL, " +
                    "$COLUMN_DESCRIPTION TEXT, " +
                    "$COLUMN_REASONING_JSON TEXT, " +
                    "$COLUMN_STATS_JSON TEXT, " +
                    "$COLUMN_ALLERGENS_JSON TEXT, " +
                    "$COLUMN_INGREDIENTS_JSON TEXT, " +
                    "$COLUMN_QUIZ_JSON TEXT, " +
                    // BOURDON'S FIX: Added the new column to the table creation script.
                    "$COLUMN_TRANSLATIONS_JSON TEXT);"

        @Volatile
        private var INSTANCE: DatabaseHelper? = null

        fun getInstance(context: Context): DatabaseHelper {
            return INSTANCE ?: synchronized(this) {
                INSTANCE ?: DatabaseHelper(context.applicationContext).also { INSTANCE = it }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onCreate(db: SQLiteDatabase?) {
        db?.execSQL(TABLE_CREATE)
    }

    override fun onUpgrade(db: SQLiteDatabase?, oldVersion: Int, newVersion: Int) {
        Log.w("DatabaseHelper", "Mise à jour de la base de données de la version $oldVersion à $newVersion, les anciennes données seront détruites.")
        // BOURDON'S FIX: A simple drop/recreate strategy is fine for debug.
        // For production, a proper migration would be needed.
        db?.execSQL("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS $TABLE_CARDS")
        onCreate(db)
    }
}

package be.heyman.android.ai.kikko.pollen

import android.Manifest
